description: The chart illustrates token counts as a function of the number of shots, with each bar partitioned into two components labeled in the legend as Reasoning (orange) and Demonstration (blue). The horizontal axis contains the categories “Number of Shots” ordered left to right as 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4. The vertical axis is labeled “Token Count” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 7000 with regularly spaced tick marks at 1000-token intervals. At 0 shots, there is a single orange bar (no blue segment) reaching 6393 tokens, with the value “6393” printed above it. For 1 shot, the stacked bar consists of an orange reasoning portion rising to a little above 4200 tokens and a thin blue demonstration cap bringing the total to roughly the mid-4400s; a red downward arrow annotation above this bar shows “-1952.” For 2 shots, the orange portion reaches around the mid-4500s with a small blue cap bringing the total to roughly the upper-4700s, annotated with a red arrow labeled “-1613.” For 3 shots, the orange portion reaches about 5000 tokens with a blue cap extending the total to roughly the mid-5300s, annotated “-1040.” For 4 shots, the orange portion is around the low- to mid-4200s with a comparatively larger blue cap bringing the total to about 5000 tokens, annotated “-1379.” The bars are not visually sorted by height beyond the natural increasing shot order on the x-axis, and the red arrow annotations and a faint dashed horizontal reference line near the upper part of the plot provide additional visual emphasis without changing the bar encoding.
